<thought>We need the retrosynthetic template (and its mapped reaction SMILES) that corresponds to the Peterson reaction for the given target molecule. The previous step should have provided a template_id and mapped_rxn, but we don't have them directly. We'll search the template catalog using functional groups broken (ketones, trimethylsilyl) and formed (C-C double bonds) to retrieve the appropriate template.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "trimethylsilyl"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
